data.body:
[P2] Wait for ReplayChildren parents before delivering input completions

A `SUCCEEDED` context with `ReplayChildren=True` still executes its user-function Start on resume, but this predicate treats it as ready immediately. If its callback completes while suspended, upgrading core while retaining the pre-change `InvocationOtelPlugin` delivers the callback end before its parent span exists. The hook raises `No parent span found`, and the notification ledger suppresses delivery when replay subsequently visits the callback, losing its terminal span. Include completed contexts that replay children in the waiting set, and add this large-result child scenario to the installed legacy-plugin regression test.
